verdict.rationale: Fern documents writing pages in Markdown. The MDX page-source and MCP docs imply MDX files and a component library exist, but no evidence names or describes tabs, callouts, code groups, or steps as authorable components. The 'tabs' in the versions docs are site navigation tabs, not in-page content components. Missing for 10: documented MDX component library covering tabs, callouts, code groups and steps; evidence these work without custom HTML; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical writer, I author pages in Markdown/MDX with rich components — tabs, callouts, code groups, steps — without writing custom HTML

citations.quote: Fern supports writing pages in Markdown
look up `docs.yml` syntax, components, and CLI commands while you build
Agents fetch the source by appending `.md` or `.mdx` to a page URL
